items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Tubby Hall was the drummer that used to play with Louis years ago... he would put on those pots for us... we rehearsed that band every day

ctx.x: I wish you could see this picture of Ben, it's beautiful. And any way we used to walk down there and rehearse every day. Well now Tubby Hall was the drummer that used to play with Louis years ago. He was up to the union and he's from New Orleans, so he would put on those pots for us, red beans and rice and things like that, and we'd chip in and give him the money and he would cook these pots. And we would eat up to the union and rehearse. We didn't have to pay no money for the rehearsal hall, we didn't have to…
We rehearsed that band every day, every day, every day. So now our first job was going to be -- was at the Metropolitan Life funeral place there, on South Parkway.
